description:
Working location: Mapletree Binh Duong Logistic Park, 18 L2-1 Tao Luc 5 Street VSIP II, Thu Dau Mot, Binh Duong
Working schedule : 5.5 days per week. No shuttle bus to transport from other provinces to the company.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Daily Operations
* Monitor all daily warehouse activities (inbound, outbound, returns) to ensure smooth operations, system accuracy, SLA compliance, and customer delivery requirements.
* Instruct, guide, and provide on-the-job training for warehouse staff to ensure compliance with SOPs, WI, quality standards, and productivity targets.
* Interact with customers to understand business requirements, order profiles, peak volumes, cut-off times, and special handling needs.
* Provide customer support during escalated situations, coordinate internal teams to resolve issues promptly, and manage overall daily workflow to maintain service levels.
* Support managers in planning and organizing daily operations, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and continuous improvement activities.
Project Development
* Participate in new project setups, including defining operational processes, standardizing procedures, and developing work instructions.
* Propose and implement improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
End Results / Accountabilities
* Ensure customer KPIs and department KPIs are met.
* Ensure all inbound and outbound shipments are planned and executed according to customer requirements.
* Maintain customer satisfaction.
* Achieve operational KPIs and meet business targets.
requirements_text:
Education
* Bachelor’s Degree.
Professional Qualifications
* Preferably with relevant professional certifications.
Experience & Skills
* 3–4 years of experience in Warehouse Management.
* Strong experience managing sizable teams.
* Analytical and strategic thinking.
* Strong customer service mindset.
* Result-oriented, good business sense, and hands-on.
* Proactive, detail-minded, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, WMS, and TMS.
* Good English communication skills (verbal & written).
* Can relocate to near the warehouse.

Kho vận, Xuất nhập khẩu / Hải quan, Logistic / Vận tải
